target: four real-shaped release-notes prompts from a developer's history
prompt: Turn the prompts in prompts.md into a skill (or skills). Put the result under skills/. My answers to your intake questions: it's for me in Claude Code, repos are on GitHub, I want it to stop and show me the notes before anything is sent.

checks.desc: a SKILL.md was written under skills/

checks.cmd: for f in skills/*/SKILL.md; do python3 .claude/skills/tune-skill/scripts/check_skill.py "$(dirname $f)" || exit 1; done

rubric: Runs an intent step and an overlap check before drafting
Drafts with draft-skill and writes trigger test cases including near-misses
Gates the result with tune-skill's validator with zero FAILs
Keeps the 'show me before sending' constraint in the skill
followups: Confirmed, that's right. Go ahead and finish it without stopping for more questions.
